_comment: Hand-curated Flight Deck featured models. No metrics are stored here: result numbers are read from registry/experiments.jsonl at render time (record ids in 'evidence'). Quoted failure-mode figures carry their source file. Every model id must exist in registry/models.json (tests/test_flight_deck.py).

featured.title: AeroTrack X2 — temporal window (X1 = seed 0)
featured.purpose: Single-target IR drone tracking on CST: a YOLO11n detector that sees three frames (t, t-4, t-8; causal) stacked as 9 channels, followed by the STE Kalman state estimator that can report 'absent'.
featured.distinguishes: The causal temporal window (vs the single-frame control) and an explicit absent decision (vs template trackers such as GlobalTrack that always output a box). Seed 0 is one checkpoint with two registered roles: X1 and X2 temporal seed 0.
featured.use_for: The reference Direction A tracker on CST. Compare with the single-frame control (what the window adds), with GlobalTrack-type trackers (what reporting absence is worth under Eq. 1), and across its three seeds (seed variability).

failure_modes.text: misses on visible frames (11-14 %), wrong-object boxes (about 10 %) and false alarms on absent frames (29-38 %), in every seed
weaker than template trackers on large targets (> 50 px): CST train has 6 large-target frames
jungle_18 (TEST): a visible-frame distractor lock that is seed-specific

featured.title: AeroTrack X2 — single-frame control
featured.purpose: The registered control of X2: the same detector architecture, training data and tracker, but the window is the current frame repeated (no temporal information).
featured.distinguishes: Differs from X2 temporal only in the input window, so a paired comparison isolates the temporal contribution.
featured.use_for: Temporal ablation (Category C): the X2 T3 test compares seed means of the temporal and single-frame arms.

failure_modes.text: about 24 % wrong-object boxes without the window (about 10 % with it); slower re-acquisition (median 31-34 vs 10-13 frames)

featured.title: AeroTrack CF — multi-source final causal system
featured.purpose: The CF final system's detector: the same causal g4 window, trained on the multi-source corpus v2 (CST + Anti-UAV + Det-Fly), with the corpus-v2 frozen STE settings.
featured.distinguishes: Multi-source training (all domains) vs X1/X2's CST-only training; the one detector evaluated on both Anti-UAV and CST.
featured.use_for: Cross-dataset behaviour (Anti-UAV IR / RGB and CST) and the deployment path (TensorRT gate in experiments/deployment).

failure_modes.text: CST false alarms on absent frames 33.1 % (registered v2 final test)

featured.title: Anti-UAV 2021 reproduction — GlobalTrack normal
featured.purpose: Direction B: GlobalTrack (query-guided Faster R-CNN, R50-FPN) fine-tuned on Anti-UAV IR without DFSC — Protocol II 'normal' of Jiang et al. 2021.
featured.distinguishes: Global search from the first-frame query; never reports absent (a box on every frame).
featured.use_for: Paper reproduction (Category G1) and the template-tracker reference on Anti-UAV; on CST it is cross-dataset.

failure_modes.text: out-of-view sequences (OV, 4 VAL sequences): 56.05 vs the paper's 78.09
scores 0 on every target-absent frame under Eq. 1 (no absence decision)

featured.title: Anti-UAV 2021 reproduction — GlobalTrack + DFSC
featured.purpose: Direction B: the same GlobalTrack fine-tuning with the paper's DFSC training strategy (alpha = 1); configs differ from 'normal' only in dfsc.alpha.
featured.distinguishes: The paper's contribution (DFSC) vs plain fine-tuning; a paired normal-vs-DFSC comparison is the reproduction's central question.
featured.use_for: Category G1: the paper reports a DFSC gain (+0.49 val, +0.68 test); this reproduction did not observe it.

failure_modes.text: same structural limitation as 'normal' (never reports absent); DFSC − normal −0.03 (val) / −0.29 (test), single seed

featured.title: GlobalTrack (CST authors' released predictions)
featured.purpose: The best published CST tracker (paper Table 3): the CST authors' released per-frame TEST predictions, scored by the official toolkit.
featured.distinguishes: External baseline. Recorded predictions only — the CST-trained checkpoint was not released, so it cannot run live; it can be replayed frame by frame next to X1 / X2's recorded TEST predictions.
featured.use_for: Recorded replay on CST TEST (read-only) and Category G2 (CST baseline-score reproduction).

failure_modes.text: never reports 'absent' on the 12,925 target-absent CST TEST frames

featured.title: Track C learned forecaster (C1 transformer)
featured.purpose: Trajectory forecasting: from a 16-frame history of target centres and sizes, predict the next 24 positions with a Gaussian uncertainty.
featured.distinguishes: Learned (transformer, absolute-position features) vs the classical cp / cv / dcv references computed on the same anchors.
featured.use_for: Category F only — forecasting metrics (ADE / FDE px, NLL) are never comparable with tracking mSA.

failure_modes.text: CST: negative transfer of the pooled model (about +5.5 px worse than dcv); the learned forecaster did not justify replacing the classical one on CST
